method: open-ended static-hidden-state + behavior + role-mediated hallucination detector v12

hidden_layer_selection.selection_rule: maximize train-OOF AUROC, then AUPRC, then later layer

behavior_support_definition: mean token logP(original answer|base) - mean token logP(original answer|intervention)

method_notes.static_hidden_state_position: last answer token by default; configurable pooling
method_notes.layer_selection: train-only OOF; test layer metrics reported but not used for selection
method_notes.span_proposal: hidden similarity only; no answer-to-span attention
method_notes.causal_interpretation_warning: Behavior interventions are causal perturbations, but the static hidden probe is correlational. v12 does not claim that hidden states themselves are causal mechanisms.
